mission: Official image mirror (ROADMAP 26, owner 'perfectionist' 2026-10-31). The 212 prints imported 2026-10-26 never mirrored: each run fetched every pending image from Bandai, then failed at R2 with a bare ClientError, exited 1 (Railway 'Deploy Crashed') and printed a multi-line summary that hit Railway's 500 logs/s cap. Now: an R2 HEAD preflight before any Bandai request, the first R2 error stops the run (at most one Bandai request), reasons carry operation, error code and HTTP status (never the message), and the summary is one bounded line.

impacts.reason: run_mirror: PREFLIGHT_KEY HEAD (all-zero digest key, absent by construction) before fetching; ClientError/BotoCoreError from mirror_one stops the run with 'storage <Operation>: <Code> (http <status>)'; database errors still record and continue. Summary: problem_reasons counts, first 20 problems, problems_omitted; printed as one compact line. No change to what is uploaded, verified or recorded.
Denied writes stop after one Bandai request and record nothing; a denied HEAD stops before any Bandai request; summary bounded; error message text never reported. 20 passed on local Postgres 16.

resources: official-images-mirror runs (R2 assets bucket, Bandai image GETs)
routes: No new route; fewer Bandai requests when R2 fails
impact.deployment_impact: Native deploy of services/api code (API, worker, official-images-mirror). No collector runtime input changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: The mirror stops on a healthy bucket, or reports wrong reasons.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: The next official-images-mirror run: its one-line summary names the R2 error code (or mirrors the 212).
